title: Entity details
responsibility: Chooses contract summary, measurements or source within entity details.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.entity
inputs.description: Required entity supplying the accessible name and unit passed to source/measurement panels.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.contract
inputs.description: Required prepared contract rows passed to the default summary view.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.measure
inputs.description: Required prepared entity measure passed to the default summary view.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.record
inputs.description: Required verification record or null, used only by the measurements panel.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.tab
inputs.description: Optional selected tab. Exactly source shows source; measurements shows measured detail; missing or any other tab uses the summary.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.repository
inputs.description: Canonical GitHub repository address for source navigation.

inputs.name: EntityDetails.commit
inputs.description: Full commit hash of the viewed entity.

outputs.name: EntityDetails
outputs.description: Named tabpanel containing the selected child view. The default shows contract/measurement summary without source; data fetching and child errors are outside this component.
